title: Sync with GitHub: merge origin/main into the rewritten branch, live board wins, both sides' fixes hold
description: Operator ratified D1, D2 and D3 on 2026-09-22. Work on branch sync/github-2026-09-22, whose history is already rewritten for D2 (see .harness/logs/commit-map-2026-09-22.md). Merge origin/main: PR #1 (portalock, Windows locking) and PR #3 (onboarding board, invariant hardening, project and landing fixes). D1: the live board wins. Keep every task file, our blackboard.json and our state.json; move PR #3's 4-task example board to examples/onboarding/ and point README, USAGE and ORCHESTRATION at it; keep its reset verb. Hand-merge blackboard.py and prevent_data_loss.py so both sides hold: PR #3's invariant fixes (done and failed terminal for every verb, no double reputation credit on re-verdict, orphan tasks credit nobody, an expired lease on a handed-off task returns to review, in_progress always carries a lease, blocked releases stale claims, the reset verb, hc.limit) and ours (Phase B dispatch plan and yield at next per PR-062 and PR-063, the T-428 guards, GUARD-MENTION-C). Where the two contradict, never choose silently: state it in the handoff note as an open question. The full suite plus PR #3's new tests must pass. Never edit signed files, trust/, constitutional/ or precedents/. Never push.

Causes, and the fix for each:
1. The board has no sanctioned way to remove a leaked literal from a note. blackboard.py is the only writer, it has no verb for this, so a leak in a note can only stay or be hand-edited. DECISION: add a `redact` verb to blackboard.py. It reads the literal from a file (never argv), requires a note, replaces the literal in every string value of blackboard.json and tasks/*.json, appends a REDACTED note to each affected task, logs a notes_redacted event, and has --dry-run for replay. The code goes after cmd_add_task so the lines PR-063 and PR-001 cite do not move. New hermetic test file: .harness/tests/test_blackboard_redact.py.
2. The literal is in 63 commits of the unpublished range. DECISION: extend the D2 rewrite to this literal, over the same range D2 rewrote (c27f216 onward). The only change is a byte replacement inside .harness/blackboard.json blobs. Author, committer, dates, messages, parents and every other blob stay the same. The pre-redaction tip 6becaa7 is kept on a new local branch backup/pre-redact-2026-09-22. backup/pre-sync-2026-09-22 and main are not touched. Nothing is pushed. The commit map gets a second table: D2 id -> new id.
